concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 3: User Story 1 - Retrieve and Preprocess Materials Data (T041)
concerns.text: Unit test T041 depends on T015, yet T015 is not completed. The test cannot run before the script it validates exists.

Task T044 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but introduces a global random‑seed helper that all downstream scripts must import. Running it in parallel with other tasks can cause nondeterministic behavior, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.

Phase 2 is declared a *blocking* prerequisite (no user‑story work may begin until it is complete), yet Phase 3 tasks for US1 (e.g., T010, T041) are listed before all Phase 2 tasks are finished (several foundational tasks remain pending). This violates the foundational‑first ordering rule.
